title: firmiana pallens
intro: Firmiana pallens, commonly known as the 'Chinese parasol tree', is a plant species that belongs to the family Malvaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, potentially aiding in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Firmiana pallens include antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals and inhibit cell proliferation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
